build.name: Render_BuildActorRecords
build.behavior: Builds the camera-relative 8-byte sprite attribute records at 0x00FF729A, seeds player/status entries, appends visible actor frame records from the 32-record actor table, applies facing and priority bits, and publishes the list count through 0x00FFEFEC.

attribute_submit.name: Render_SubmitPlayerSprites
attribute_submit.behavior: Transfers the generated 8-byte records from 0x00FF729A to VDP_DATA using the VDP control word at 0x001CB2 and the count at 0x00FFEFEC.

payload_submit.name: Render_SubmitActorSprites
payload_submit.behavior: Transfers 14-byte actor sprite payload records from 0x00FF769A to VDP_DATA after programming the actor-sprite destination and waits for the VDP FIFO before finalizing the transfer.

conclusion: The gameplay render path separates sprite attribute-list construction, attribute submission, and actor sprite-payload submission. The builder's camera-relative culling and actor-table traversal are distinct from the two VDP transfer routines.
